params.prompt: Graphic novel inked illustration, painted tableau, a frozen moment. The risen Christ stands with one hand extended toward the viewer, face turned in mercy, bold ink linework and flat cel shading. The camera performs a slow, reverent push-in toward the extended hand and face. Nothing else moves -- figure, drapery, and light stay fixed as drawn. No invented motion, no morphing, no new elements, no camera shake. Painted tableau stays still; only the camera moves.
